description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

🔥 PlainApp is an open-source app that lets you securely manage your phone from a web browser. Access files, media, contacts, SMS, calls, and more through a simple, easy-to-use interface on your desktop.
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.
Get tasks and ideas out of your head. A free GTD to-do app for desktop and mobile. Works offline, no account needed

程序员鱼皮编程导航原创全栈项目，一款极客范儿的命令行浏览器主页与开源 Web 终端组件（Geek Browser Startpage & Web Terminal）。项目基于 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite + Pinia + Ant Design Vue + Node.js + Express + Sequelize + MySQL + Redis 实现，从 0 自研可复用的微终端和插件化命令系统，支持多引擎聚合搜索、类 Linux 书签空间管理、Tab 自动补全、全局快捷键、中英翻译、待办清单、变量命名、全网热榜、在线音乐、摸鱼小游戏、Docker 部署与 Chrome 新标签页扩展。既能作为程序员日常提效的个人起始页，也很适合前端进阶与全栈系统设计实战。

NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
Cotabby is local AI autocomplete for your entire Mac. Open source. On device. Everywhere you type.
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.
Cross-platform 2D game engine focused on ultimate productivity built in .NET
Hyprland-style tiling window manager for macOS: automatic dwindle (BSP) layout, 10 workspaces, keyboard-first, SIP stays on
A lightweight, open-source Alfred-style launcher for Windows.
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.

Free, on-device AI dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Sub-second dictation with Parakeet and Whisper on Apple Silicon, plus optional AI polish. EnviousMeet (Beta): record calls with no bot, get who-said-what transcripts and AI summaries on your Mac. No account, no subscription, open source. Your audio never leaves your Mac.

JuhRadial MX 🖱️🖥️  is an alternative for the missing Logi Options + for Linux | a beautiful radial menu for Logitech MX Master mice (KDE Plasma 6, Hyprland, Wayland) - Now also supporting the new MX Keypad.
